# mailcow_syncjob_source (Resource)

Provides a sync source in mailcow (mailcow 2026-11 or later).
A sync source holds the IMAP server that sync jobs (`mailcow_syncjob`) copy mail from;
it can be used by any number of sync jobs.

Sources with OAuth2 (`XOAUTH2`) are not supported.

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "mailcow_syncjob_source" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
  host = "imap.example.com"
  port = 993
  enc  = "SSL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) the IMAP server mails are synced from (--host1), in lower case
- `name` (String) name of the sync source, unique per creator

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) is the source active; new sync jobs need an active source
- `auth_type` (String) the authentication mechanism (`PLAIN`, `LOGIN`, `CRAM-MD5`) (--authmech1)
- `description` (String) description of the sync source
- `domains` (Set of String) the domains that may use the source, in lower case (only with `scope = "domain"`, then required)
- `enc` (String) the encryption used to connect to the IMAP server (`SSL`, `TLS` for STARTTLS, `PLAIN`)
- `port` (Number) the port of the IMAP server (--port1)
- `scope` (String) who may use the source for sync jobs: `all` (everyone, admins only), `domain` (the mailboxes of `domains`) or `user` (the mailboxes in `users`, without `users` only the creator and admins)
- `users` (Set of String) the mailboxes that may use the source, in lower case (only with `scope = "user"`)
- `verify_cert` (Boolean) verify the certificate of the IMAP server

### Read-Only

- `created_by` (String) the account that created the source
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

A sync source is imported by its id, as shown in mailcow or returned by `/api/v1/get/syncjob_source/all`:

```shell
terraform import mailcow_syncjob_source.example 42
```
